name: QTT Tenant Feature Override
description: A one-off grant or revoke of a feature_key for one tenant+product, layered on top of the plan's own QTT Plan Feature defaults inside get_entitlements(). Sales/support exception mechanism — never tenant self-service (see permissions below).

fields.label: Override Value
fields.description: Same convention as QTT Plan Feature.limit_value — replaces the plan's own value for this feature_key entirely, never merged/added.

fields.label: Expires On
fields.description: An expired override is ignored by get_entitlements() — never deleted automatically, so the record of why it was granted is retained.
